title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 002
review_goal: Differentiate the five live MingCute user silhouette variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Round head above a curved shoulder line with short side arms
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs a simple generic person or account profile symbol without a border.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use when another user variant with a circular border flat bar or square head is required.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the most open shoulder shape with a round head and separate short side arms.

items.depicts_observation: Round head above a rounded horizontal body bar with a flat bottom
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs a compact person symbol with a thicker body bar under the head.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use when a curved shoulder outline circular frame or square headed person variant is expected.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot differs from the other user icons by using a broad rounded body bar instead of shoulders.

items.depicts_observation: Round head above a pointed oval shoulder ring with an open center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a softer profile silhouette built from an oval shoulder ring under the head.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use when the product needs the flatter body bar bordered circle or square headed user shape.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a hollow pointed oval torso shape rather than the flatter bar or open shoulders.

items.depicts_observation: Small person bust centered inside a circular profile border ring
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs a profile icon contained inside a circular badge or account frame.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the unframed user silhouettes when the enclosing circular border would be visually misleading.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only user variant with a full outer circular ring enclosing the person bust.

items.depicts_observation: Squared head above a collar notch and short shoulder line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface needs a more formal person silhouette with a squared head and collar shaped neckline.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the round headed user variants when the visible square head and collar notch matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot stands apart by showing a squared head and a visible center collar notch below it.
